case_number: CRI. APPL. NO./SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (Crl.) No.2029 OF 2018
summary: High Court improperly exercised revisional jurisdiction under Section 397 Cr.P.C. to discharge accused post-charge framing; order rejecting charge modification under Section 216 Cr.P.C. is interlocutory and non-justiciable in revision; precedent requires restraint in revising charge-related orders absent gross error; dismissal of vexatious discharge attempts confirmed; revision bar against interlocutory orders affirmed.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court order set aside; trial court's order upholding charge against Respondent No.2 restored.
